recent.title: Last 200 events
recent.sql: select ts, source, event_type, event_name, device_name, body from events order by id desc limit 200

per_device_per_day.title: Events per device per day (last 30 days)
per_device_per_day.sql: select date(ts) as day, source, coalesce(device_name, device_id, event_type) as device, count(*) as n from events where ts >= date('now', '-30 days') group by day, source, device order by day desc, n desc

silent_devices.title: YoLink devices by last event
silent_devices.sql: select n.name, n.type, max(l.ts) as last_event from device_names n left join log l on l.source = n.source and l.device_id = n.device_id and coalesce(l.event_name, '') not in ('getState', 'getDeviceList') where n.source = 'yolink' group by n.device_id order by last_event

alarm_recent.title: Last 200 alarm panel messages (without zone-timer dumps)
alarm_recent.sql: select received_at, event_type, event_name, device_id, body from log where source = 'evl' and event_type <> 'zone_timers' order by id desc limit 200

unifi_recent.title: Last 200 UniFi syslog events
unifi_recent.sql: select received_at, event_type, event_name, body from log where source = 'unifi' order by id desc limit 200
